| Code | Default | Reached when |

| `file_size` | No limit | The input is larger than `DocumentLimits.max_file_size`. |

| `object_count` | No limit | The document has more objects than `DocumentLimits.max_objects`. |
| `object_depth` | No limit | An object nests arrays and dictionaries deeper than `DocumentLimits.max_object_depth`. |
| `decompressed_size` | No limit | A stream decodes to more than `DocumentLimits.max_decompressed_size`. |
| `page_content_size` | No limit | A content stream of a page decodes to more than `DocumentLimits.max_page_content_size`. |
| `total_decompressed_size` | No limit | The streams that one operation decodes are larger together than `DocumentLimits.max_total_decompressed_size`. |
| `decompression_unverifiable` | — | A stream uses a filter whose decoded size cannot be bounded while a decoding limit applies. |
| `stream_filter_count` | 16 filters | A stream chains more filters than its limit. |
| `interpretation_size` | No limit | The PDF data handed to the interpreter is larger than `DocumentLimits.max_interpretation_size`. |
| `interpretation_fuel` | No limit | Interpretation uses more fuel than the operation allows. |
| `content_operation_count` | 1,048,576 operations | Content holds more operations than the call's `max_operations`, or `Page.operations` reads more than 1,048,576. |
| `content_stream_size` | 64 MiB | A page's content streams, decoded and joined, are larger than 64 MiB when `Page.operations` reads them. |
| `content_input_size` | 64 MiB | The content that `Operations.parse` reads is larger than the call's `max_size`, or the content that an assignment to `Page.operations` writes is larger than 64 MiB. |
| `content_element_count` | 262,144 elements | `Page.content` reads more glyphs, path and clip segments, dash lengths, and items than the call's `max_elements`, or `Pages.new_from_image` reads more than 4,096 frames or 256 million pixels of one image. |
| `text_glyph_count` | 262,144 glyphs | `Page.text`, `Page.words`, `Page.layout`, or `Document.text` collects more glyphs of one page than the call's `max_glyphs`. |

| `search_input_size` | 4 KiB | The text that `Page.search` looks for is longer than 4,096 bytes in UTF-8. |
| `search_hit_count` | 4,096 matches | `Page.search` finds more matches than the call's `max_hits`. |
| `text_rule_count` | 4,096 rules | Styled text or table extraction collects more than 4,096 vector rules, including inferred table dividers. |

| `ocr_detection_count` | 4,096 regions | OCR detection finds more than 4,096 candidate regions across its tiles before merging overlaps. |
| `ocr_text_size` | 32 MiB | OCR recognition produces more than 32 MiB of UTF-8 text before confidence filtering. |
| `ocr_model_size` | 64 MiB | The detector, recognizer, and dictionary that `OcrEngine` loads hold more bytes together than its `max_model_size`. |
| `ocr_dictionary_entries` | 65,536 entries | The dictionary that `OcrEngine` loads has more lines than the limit. |
| `stream_data_size` | 64 MiB | Reading a stream returns more bytes than the call's `max_size`. |
| `object_value_depth` | 32 levels | A value written to the document nests arrays and dictionaries deeper than its limit. |

| `render_output_size` | 512 MiB | The images that `doc.render` encodes write more bytes in all than the call's `max_size`. |
| `password_input_size` | 127 bytes | A password is longer in UTF-8 than PDF 2.0 allows. |

| `annotation_dash_count` | 32 lengths | An annotation border has more than 32 dash lengths. |

| `form_field_parent_depth` | 64 levels | A form widget's field parent chain contains more than 64 existing fields. |
| `script_size` | 1 MiB | A form script, or the scripts of one field or widget together, are longer than 1 MiB in UTF-8, read or written. |
| `text_edit_forms` | 4,096 drawings | `Page.replace_text` reaches Form XObjects nested deeper than 16, or more than 4,096 drawings of them. |

| `shaped_glyph_count` | 1,048,576 glyphs | Shaping one string in an embedded face takes more characters, or gives more glyphs, than the limit. |

| `named_destination_depth` | 32 levels | The named-destination tree has more than 32 levels. |
| `named_destination_text_size` | 16 MiB | The names of the document's named destinations are longer than 16 MiB together. |
| `toc_entry_count` | 65,536 entries | The outline holds more than 65,536 items or 131,072 links between them, a list of items holds more than 65,536 children, or `doc.outline` is set to more than 65,536 entries. |
| `toc_text_size` | 16 MiB | The titles and target texts of the outline are longer than 16 MiB together, as the document encodes them or as they are returned. |
| `toc_input_size` | 16 MiB | The titles and target texts that setting `doc.outline` or editing an item writes are longer than 16 MiB together in UTF-8 or as PDF text strings, or leave the outline's text above that. |
| `structure_tree_count` | 256 levels | A structural edit of pages walks a structure tree deeper than 256 levels including its root, a parent tree or ID tree deeper than 32 levels, or an acyclic reference chain longer than 32 references. |

| `cancelled` | — | A cancellation token of the operation is cancelled. |
| `annotation_quad_count` | 4,096 quadrilaterals | A text-markup annotation has more than 4,096 quadrilaterals. |
| `annotation_point_count` | 65,536 points | An annotation's geometry, including generated squiggly points, has more than 65,536 points. |
| `annotation_appearance_size` | 16 MiB | One generated annotation appearance contains more than 16 MiB of content. |
| `annotation_synthesis_count` | 4,096 appearances | One render synthesizes more than 4,096 missing annotation appearances across the document. |
| `annotation_synthesis_point_count` | 262,144 points | Missing annotation appearances generated for one render contain more than 262,144 path points together. |
